never_record: MFA, passkey, recovery, or one-time-code screens
API keys, tokens, cookies, or secret environment values
raw private email, Slack, meeting, or client records
policy.external_action_rule: Training stops at preview unless Dillon separately approves the exact send, post, publish, spend, deploy, or account change.
policy.canonical_write_rule: Grok Bots return artifacts, evidence, and proposals. Codex acting as Marketing Chief remains the only canonical queue writer and final completion authority.
policy.recording_finish_line: Every recording ends with route, artifact paths, sources and freshness, checks, assumptions, privacy state, approval state, external action attempted, and next safest action.

routines.name: Sync and test the shared agent vault
routines.trigger: Start of the first marketing, client, design, content, reporting, or website task of the day
routines.demo_input: The real agent-vault path with no secret data
steps: Read AGENTS.md and the exact project route
Report queue revision and source health
routines.approval_boundary: Read and generated-projection operations only
routines.success_evidence: Both scripts pass and exact source locations are named

routines.name: Validate access and session continuity
routines.trigger: Before an account-dependent task
routines.demo_input: Sanitized Access Broker metadata and synthetic expired-session states

Prefer an existing authorized session or OAuth route

routines.approval_boundary: Never reveal or capture a credential value
routines.success_evidence: Exact account and allowed capabilities are confirmed without secret exposure

routines.name: Review overnight automations and watchdogs

routines.demo_input: Synthetic scheduler, checkpoint, collector, and log fixtures
steps: Separate configured, locally healthy, and externally delivered states
Do not advance state after failure
routines.approval_boundary: No restart, retry, checkpoint mutation, or provider change without task-specific authority
routines.success_evidence: Failures are evidence-backed and healthy status is not inferred from configuration alone

routines.name: Triage Gmail requests
routines.trigger: Bounded Gmail intake window or explicit email request
routines.demo_input: Synthetic full email thread with To, Cc, dates, and a client alias
steps: Identify request, urgency, owner, audience, decision, and promised deliverable
Create a deliverable task or draft proposal
routines.output: Redacted intake card with source locator
routines.approval_boundary: Read only; no send and no consumption of login or MFA messages
routines.success_evidence: The actual deliverable is inferred and recipients are correctly scoped

routines.name: Triage Slack requests

steps: Prepare a deliverable or response proposal
routines.approval_boundary: No channel joins, posts, reactions, or membership changes
routines.success_evidence: Thread locator and client route are exact and no cross-client context is blended

steps: Separate decisions, commitments, requests, ideas, and background
Route each item to one client or internal project
routines.approval_boundary: No external follow-up or calendar change

routines.name: Triage monitoring and system alerts
routines.trigger: New monitoring alert, failed job, deployment issue, or health warning
routines.demo_input: Synthetic alerts with duplicate, stale, and real-failure examples
steps: Determine user impact and exact scope
routines.approval_boundary: No destructive recovery or production mutation
routines.success_evidence: Impact, scope, evidence, and next safe action are explicit

routines.name: Resolve client, account, repository, and environment

steps: Select brand, account, portal, repository, worktree, environment, and owner

routines.name: Deduplicate and prioritize work

Choose owner, next action, and finish line
routines.approval_boundary: Bot may propose but cannot write the canonical queue
routines.success_evidence: Top priority has a defensible score and duplicate work is avoided

routines.name: Infer the real deliverable
routines.trigger: A request is clear enough to act but does not name the artifact precisely
routines.demo_input: Synthetic vague requests such as fix this, report back, or make this better
steps: Separate build, review, approval, and delivery states
routines.approval_boundary: Do not broaden scope into a materially different action
routines.success_evidence: The finish line is concrete enough for an independent checker

routines.name: Plan dependencies and approval gates

routines.demo_input: Synthetic dependency graph with research, build, QA, and approval nodes
steps: Place external actions behind exact approvals
routines.approval_boundary: No agent can grant itself new authority
routines.success_evidence: Every node has an input contract, output contract, and owner

routines.name: Run repository and worktree preflight

Run focused tests and production build

State unresolved risk and one next action

Reduce human gates to the smallest necessary set

Verify sustained inbound and reply behavior

routines.success_evidence: Behavior is verified from current logs and end-to-end runtime evidence
